kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتساهم (form VI)
# نَتَسَاهَمُ (natasāhamu) /na.ta.saː.ha.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَسَاهَمَ (tasāhama)
# نَتَسَاهَمَ (natasāhama) /na.ta.saː.ha.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَسَاهَمَ (tasāhama)
# نَتَسَاهَمْ (natasāham) /na.ta.saː.ham/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَسَاهَمَ (tasāhama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
